name: Section 4.1 Difficult Case: Bank Fixed Deposit Interest Discrepancy
complaint_text: I invested in a fixed deposit through my bank's app. The interest credited is lower than what I was promised. I want to complain to SEBI.
difficulty_note: Uses investment vocabulary ('invested', 'fixed deposit') and names SEBI, but fixed deposits are governed by RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021.

name: Stock Broker Delayed Fund Payout Beyond T+1
complaint_text: I sold equity shares of Infosys on Monday through my Zerodha trading account. The funds payout was due on Tuesday (T+1), but even after 5 days the broker has not credited Rs 1,45,000 to my bank account and their support is unresponsive.
difficulty_note: Core SEBI intermediary obligation under SCORES 2.0 with 21-day statutory ATR timeline.

name: Unauthorized F&O Trades Executed by Broker
complaint_text: My broker AngleOne executed 10 lots of BankNifty option contracts in my trading account without my authorization or consent, resulting in a loss of Rs 85,000. They have not provided order voice recordings or IP audit logs.
difficulty_note: SEBI-CIR-05(d) mandates broker must furnish order confirmation and voice logs within 7 working days.

name: Mutual Fund Redemption Proceeds Delayed Beyond 3 Days
complaint_text: I submitted a valid redemption request for 500 units in Nippon India Small Cap Fund on 10th October. The AMC accepted the request but failed to credit redemption proceeds of Rs 75,000 within 3 working days. I demand interest at 15% p.a. for the delay.
entity_name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
difficulty_note: Regulation 53B mandates 3-day turnaround and 15% annual penal interest for AMC delay.

name: Mutual Fund Failure to Dispatch IDCW Dividend Payout
complaint_text: HDFC Mutual Fund declared an IDCW dividend for HDFC Top 100 Fund with record date 1st September. Over 15 working days have passed and dividend warrant of Rs 12,400 has not been credited to my account.
difficulty_note: Regulation 53A stipulates 7 working days maximum for dividend warrant dispatch.

name: Depository Participant Unauthorized Demat Share Debit
complaint_text: 500 shares of Tata Motors were transferred out of my CDSL demat account through depository participant ICICI Securities without any Delivery Instruction Slip (DIS) signed by me or OTP confirmation.
difficulty_note: Depository Participant servicing obligation under SEBI-CIR-02(c).

name: Registrar RTA Refusing to Issue Duplicate Share Certificates
complaint_text: I submitted all indemnity bonds, affidavits, and succession certificates to KFin Technologies 60 days ago for issuance of duplicate share certificates of Reliance Industries, but the RTA has not issued them or updated the register.
difficulty_note: Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) grievance governed by SEBI SCORES.

name: Listed Company Non-Payment of Declared Equity Dividend
complaint_text: ITC Limited declared an equity dividend of Rs 6.25 per share at its AGM. As a registered shareholder holding 1000 shares on the record date, I have not received the dividend payment of Rs 6,250 even after 45 days.
difficulty_note: Listed company corporate action failure governed by SEBI-CIR-02(e).

name: Failed Bank ATM Withdrawal With Money Debited
complaint_text: I tried withdrawing Rs 10,000 from State Bank of India ATM. Cash was not dispensed due to machine timeout but Rs 10,000 was debited from my SBI savings account. It has been 10 days and bank has not auto-reversed the amount.
difficulty_note: Pure banking ATM transaction failure under RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021.

name: Unauthorized Net Banking UPI Fraudulent Debits
complaint_text: Two fraudulent UPI transactions of Rs 25,000 each took place from my Axis Bank savings account through an unknown merchant app without me receiving any OTP. Axis Bank branch has rejected my compensation request.
difficulty_note: Electronic banking fraud governed by RBI digital transactions ombudsman.

name: Commercial Bank Credit Card Hidden Annual Fee Levy
complaint_text: ICICI Bank charged an annual membership fee of Rs 3,500 plus GST on my credit card which was promised to be Lifetime Free (LTF) during tele-calling issuance.
difficulty_note: Credit card dispute falls under RBI-IOS-08C.

name: Life Insurance Death Claim Repudiation
complaint_text: Max Life Insurance rejected my deceased father's term life insurance policy death claim of Rs 50,00,000 citing pre-existing medical conditions that were already disclosed during policy proposal 4 years ago.
difficulty_note: Insurance policy dispute falls under IRDAI Bima Bharosa and Insurance Ombudsman.

name: Health Insurance Cashless Hospitalization Rejection
complaint_text: Star Health Insurance repudiated my hospitalization cashless claim of Rs 1,80,000 for emergency appendectomy surgery at Apollo Hospital stating non-payable consumable deduction.
entity_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co Ltd
difficulty_note: Health insurance regulated by IRDAI.

name: National Pension System (NPS) Contribution Missing in PRAN
complaint_text: My monthly employer contribution of Rs 15,000 for National Pension System (NPS) for July and August was deducted from salary but has not been credited to my Tier 1 PRAN account by the Point of Presence / CRA Protean.
difficulty_note: PFRDA holds exclusive regulatory jurisdiction over NPS and APY.

name: Unlisted Private Company Shareholder Dispute
complaint_text: I am a 15% minority shareholder in XYZ Logistics Private Limited (an unlisted private firm). The managing director has refused to inspect books of accounts and removed my name from director registers without board resolution.
difficulty_note: Unlisted private company matters fall under Ministry of Corporate Affairs / NCLT, not SEBI.

name: Claiming Compensation for Trading Option Losses Due to Market Volatility
complaint_text: I bought out-of-the-money Call Options on Nifty 50 expiry day. The market fell sharply and all my options expired at zero value, losing me Rs 3,20,000. I want SEBI to order the stock exchange to refund my lost capital because market was manipulated.
entity_name: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd
difficulty_note: SEBI-CIR-04(c) explicitly rules out claims seeking compensation for speculative market losses.

name: Grievance Already Sub-Judice Before High Court
complaint_text: Our dispute regarding inheritance of 50,000 shares of Bajaj Auto is currently under trial in Civil Suit No. 402/2022 before the Hon'ble High Court of Bombay. The company won't transfer shares pending court injunction. I want SEBI to overrule and transfer immediately.
difficulty_note: SEBI-CIR-04(a) bars complaints pending before courts or tribunals (sub-judice).

name: Split Jurisdiction: Bank Blocked ASBA IPO Funds But Broker Failed to Upload Bid
complaint_text: I applied for the Tata Tech IPO using UPI ASBA through Kotak Bank. Kotak Bank successfully placed a hold on Rs 15,000 in my savings account. However, my broker Upstox failed to upload my bidding application number to the National Stock Exchange portal before the 5 PM cutoff. When allotment occurred, registrar KFin rejected the bid as unsubmitted, but Kotak Bank refuses to release the hold on my Rs 15,000, claiming broker confirmation is missing.
difficulty_note: Requirement F7: Mandatory escalation when dispute spans both RBI (SCSB bank lien) and SEBI (syndicate broker bid).

name: Split Jurisdiction: Net Banking Transfer Debited But Broker Ledger Uncredited
complaint_text: I transferred Rs 2,00,000 via HDFC NetBanking payment gateway to fund my Groww trading account for margin. HDFC Bank debited my savings account with reference UTR HDFC987654. However, Groww claims the payment aggregator Razorpay encountered an API timeout and funds never hit their escrow account. Both HDFC Bank and Groww customer desks refuse responsibility and blame each other.
difficulty_note: Requirement F7: Dual entity split involving bank payment aggregator (RBI) and broker ledger (SEBI).

name: Unregulated Entity: Crypto Exchange Lost Customer Bitcoin Wallet Assets
complaint_text: I deposited 0.5 BTC on WazirX crypto trading platform. Following a reported security breach, they froze withdrawals and my portfolio worth Rs 28,00,000 is inaccessible. I want SEBI to freeze their bank accounts and return my cryptocurrency.
difficulty_note: Unregistered entity and virtual digital assets fall outside SEBI securities regulatory purview.

name: Mutual Fund Failure to Issue Consolidated Account Statement (CAS)
complaint_text: I performed multiple purchase and switch transactions in Axis Mutual Fund across August and September. It is now end of October and AMC has failed to issue the mandatory Consolidated Account Statement (CAS).
difficulty_note: Regulation 53C mandates monthly CAS dispatch by 15th of following month.
